// interface follows the Mac's language unless the `language` setting names
// one. What the model reads from the mod (setup notes, initiative prompts) is
// in the same language, so the OS answers in it.

export type Strings = (typeof STRINGS)['ru']

/** The interface language from what macOS lists first: Russian, else English. */
export function langFrom(preferred: string): Lang {
  return /^\s*\(?\s*"?ru\b/i.test(preferred) ? 'ru' : 'en'
}
